03 / About BPI

Battery manufacturing.
Built on experience.

Founded in 2002, Shenzhen Better Power Battery Co., Ltd. integrates battery research and development, production and sales. Its portfolio includes rechargeable batteries, battery packs and energy storage solutions.

BPI offers battery cell customization, BMS customization and battery structure customization services. Discuss your application with the team in Shenzhen, China.
